Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

State which commands or CI runs actually verified the change, their results and any limits. For synchronization fixes, include a meaningful regression case and consider field ownership, exact identity, concurrent edits and recovery.

Update the matching operator/developer documentation when behavior or support changes.

AI assistance: disclose substantial use and explain how the result was checked. Do not claim manual review, security auditing or tests that did not occur. See AI_USAGE.md and CONTRIBUTING.md.
